summary.en-US: Self-cleaning Firefox containers for temporary browsing - transparent, bounded cleanup, fully offline.

version.approval_notes: Ephemeral uses a readable, non-minified TypeScript bundle and has no runtime dependencies. Rebuild with `npm ci && npm run package`. There are no host permissions, content scripts, telemetry, remote code, or outbound extension-page connections. The optional downloads permission erases only download-manager entries filtered by Firefox cookieStoreId and never deletes files. The optional 'global history sweep' (off by default) erases the entire browsing history on every container cleanup because Firefox offers no container-scoped history API; it is a labeled dashboard setting and the cleanup report marks that step as global. Browser-exit policy runs on the next runtime.onStartup because WebExtensions cannot guarantee asynchronous shutdown cleanup.

release_notes.en-US: Ephemeral moves to a new add-on identity (ephemeral@mheci.github.io) with a rebranded 'burner container' icon and a modernized design across the popup, onboarding, and dashboard. Existing installs of previous versions will not auto-update to this release; install it fresh from this release's signed XPI.
